data.long_meaning: Joziah is a Hebrew name derived from the elements Yah (God) and Yahsh (salvation). In the Old Testament, Joziah was a king of Judah who, at a young age, initiated religious reforms in Jerusalem. This name carries the spiritual significance of God's saving power and the importance of faith and obedience in one's life. The name Joziah carries the meaning “God is salvation” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Joziah usually hope their child will grow to embody god is salvation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
